record.question: Who is the present governor of Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
record.explanation: Answer B: Urjit Patel. The official MPSC result identifies this Assistant Grade examination as held on 10 April 2018. The RBI announced Patel took office on 4 September 2016; its later announcement dates Shaktikanta Das’s succession to 12 December 2018. Therefore Patel was governor on the exam date. The printed present-tense question is interpreted only in its April 2018 exam context, not as a current-affairs claim. Independently reviewed unofficial answer, not an examiner key.
